use_cases: Use when maintaining long-term narrative consistency across multiple book chapters.
Implement when requiring automated AIGC detection and rewriting to reduce AI-generated patterns.
Configure when needing third-party system notifications via Webhooks with HMAC signing.
Use when extracting specific authorial style fingerprints to inject into future writing prompts.
Configure when setting up 26-dimension audits including narrative logic and AI-tell detection.
